note: Base-game body facts (names, UV boxes and pixel regions only; no game data). Keys are .mesh paths, lowercase. removable: named parts a derived body can drop (any triangle with a vertex mostly on bone whose UV centroid lies in uv_px of a tex-px texture). hair_region: the diffuse's hair (x0 y0 x1 y1 [tex]) skinned additions use when no hair swatch fits. SPEC Track R. areas: named texture areas as bone groups for the generic 28-bone skeleton (a body may override them under its own "areas"); a triangle belongs to the area of most of its vertices' dominant bones (textures.areas); recipes target them as area:<name>. Areas are listed broad before narrow (arms before forearms, legs before shins): finishes apply in this order. bands: finer areas cut from a parent area along an axis, as fractions of the parent's own extent on that axis (0 = its lowest or innermost vertex, 1 = its highest or outermost): height is y, reach is |x|, the distance out from the body's middle (arms hang in an A-pose, so sleeves split by reach). A triangle of the parent belongs to the band holding its centroid. A body may override them under its own "bands". Fractions measured on western_generic_01_type1 and african_generic_03_type1 (torso y 7.6-14.3, arms |x| 2.0-5.7); belt: the type1 texture's painted belt is at 0.38-0.45.
